text: The confirmation of a screening proposal reaches this service as one REST operation, POST /api/recovery/deviation/v1/cases/{caseId}/deviations, called under the confirming person's own identity with an Idempotency-Key, and its request carries agentVersion, pausedState and the segment pair the run carried in addition to the fields of the legacy Java signature; a replay of the same key answers the first result with 200 and writes nothing.
why: The legacy section 12 publishes a Java interface that no microservice can call in-process under DP-11, while deviation.paused_state is a required column (TSD S8 T3.1), the decision record of legacy AC4 names the agent version SCREENING@P2/PR2, and the mode gate of legacy BR1 needs the segment pair; the Ownership Map already gives S8 POST /cases/{caseId}/deviations, so the operation is not new, only wider.

text: One open deviation per case and code is enforced by a partial unique index on deviation (case_id, deviation_code) where cleared_at is null, added as one step in the per-service Flyway sequence of rwb_deviation; the guard in front of it only produces the message, and the index violation is answered as 409 with MSG-GEN-004. The index name is a design choice no source fixes.
why: Legacy AC7 and AC8 require one deviation for a code that is already open and one deviation for two simultaneous confirmations, and no source publishes a key, a constraint or a lock for it; the table and its columns already exist, so an index is the smallest true rule.
